title: My Projects
text:
PORTFOLIO

Show all Georgetown UVA Applications Publications





GitHub View Project


VibeCheck
Georgetown University • DSAN 6700: Machine Learning App Deployment
Discover Washington, DC restaurants by their vibe rather than food type. Enter a text description (“cozy”, “romantic”, “trendy”) or a reference photo and VibeCheck returns matching vibes by extracting multimodal embeddings from images & text (CLIP + SentenceBERT) and returning fast similarity search via vector indexing.





GitHub View Project


HairNet
Georgetown University • DSAN 6600: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
The first deep learning model for full Andre Walker 10-class hair typing. Achieves 53.7% top-1 and 88.7% within-one-class accuracy using EfficientNetV2-M with CORN ordinal regression, trained on a custom ~14k-image dataset. Deployed as an interactive Hugging Face Space.





IEEE FEDS Notes


LLM on a Budget: Active Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Classification of Large Text Corpora
Federal Reserve Board
Introduces M-RARU, an active learning algorithm that intelligently selects which data points a large language model should label when training smaller “student” models. Reduces samples needed by up to 80% vs. random sampling, cutting costs and training time while preserving classification accuracy. Published IEEE Big Data 2025 and as a FEDS Notes paper.

Hidden Numbers: Human Trafficking in Europe
Georgetown University • DSAN 5000
Comprehensive analysis using machine learning to understand factors influencing human trafficking detection and government response across Europe.
